owner_statement: 批准实际分析预算，通过实际分析恢复数据并开展MAML实验
stop_conditions: non-zero solver exit or timeout: stop the batch, no retry
ledger accounting violation or open reservation: stop the batch
polar missing, unparsable, or invalid rows: stop the batch
raw file hash mismatch or admission failure: stop the batch
matched lift not bracketed after two refine starts for a design: stop that design
any physical anomaly, resource exhaustion, or unplanned restart: stop and report

backup.disclosure: This is not an independent failure-domain backup.
